app_store.name: Chowk: calm city routes
app_store.subtitle: Quiet streets, open survey
app_store.promotional_text: New: a field card for every place. Save the street plan, the calm score and your own note as one image.
app_store.description:
Chowk is a survey of central Bengaluru that routes you by how a street feels, not just how fast it moves.

Every street in the survey carries a noise grade. Pick a route and you see the average, next to the quietest option, before you walk it. Turn on the quiet layer and the map shows which lanes are calm and which are not.

What you can do:
- Search shops, streets and metro stations, and browse twelve categories
- Walk, cycle, drive or take the metro, with fares and step free options
- See a noise comparison on every route, and a calm score on every place
- Save places to lists and keep a private note on each one
- Report a broken pavement or an unsafe crossing, and mark it fixed when it is
- Print a field card: a drawn street plan, the calm score and your note

What Chowk does not do: no advertising, no sponsored pins, no star ratings, no tracking. Your saved places and notes stay in this browser, and you can export them as a JSON file at any time.

The map is drawn from OpenStreetMap data, credited to its contributors under the ODbL licence. The survey covers central Bengaluru only; outside it the app says so rather than guessing.

Times are estimates from a typical weekday pattern, not live traffic.
app_store.whats_new: Field cards, a calm score on every place, and step free routing.
